description: This PHP source file defines the 'Links' class within the SuiteCRM API module, responsible for generating JSON API compliant link objects, including pagination, self-reference, meta-information, and related links.

classes.name: Links
classes.description: Represents a collection of hyperlink references following the JSON API specification, supporting pagination, meta-data, and related links, with fluent interface methods for setting properties.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new Links object.

methods.name: withSelf
methods.description: Sets the 'self' URL for the link object after URL validation.

methods.name: withPagination
methods.description: Enables pagination links display even if values are not set.

methods.name: withFirst
methods.description: Sets the 'first' pagination link after URL validation.

methods.name: withPrev
methods.description: Sets the 'prev' pagination link after URL validation.

methods.name: withNext
methods.description: Sets the 'next' pagination link after URL validation.

methods.name: withLast
methods.description: Sets the 'last' pagination link after URL validation.

methods.name: withMeta
methods.description: Merges provided meta information into existing meta data.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Generates a JSON API compliant associative array representing the link object.

methods.name: hasSelf
methods.description: Checks if the 'self' URL is set.

methods.name: hasHref
methods.description: Checks if an arbitrary href is set.

methods.name: hasMeta
methods.description: Checks if meta data is set.

methods.name: hasRelated
methods.description: Checks if a related link is set.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates whether a given string is a well-formed URL.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Assigns a PSR-compliant logger instance to the class.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves the logger instance, creating a default if none is set.
